title: Every kit's Use theme button lands the builder on the accent picked on /themes

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-05: Use this theme on CyberWitch dropped the picked accent; audit every other kit the same way.

detail: CyberWitch's accent carry (#4675) matches the /themes swatch by name or hex against the builder's kit list. Eight other kits sent ids like general, venues, fall that matched nothing, and their swatches (Violet, Magenta, Moss, Slate, Fall, Olive, Madder, Mint and more) were not in the builder's list. The /themes Use button now sends the swatch hex, and the builder's kit lists include every swatch the kit's /themes page offers, after the kit's own accents. A test fails if any swatch on any kit page does not resolve.

verify.evidence: preview-site.test.ts: every swatch of every kit page resolves by hex, and no kit lists a name or colour twice.
